newsitem.title: USA: American Air pilots board to continue meetings.
newsitem.headline: American Air pilots board to continue meetings.

text.p: The board of American Airlines pilots association said Thursday it plans to continue scheduled meetings with union members over the next two weeks regardless of the outcome of a vote on the carrier's latest labor contract proposal.

"Jim (Sovich) still wants the road show regardless of the vote," said Wally Pitts, a spokesman for the Allied Pilots Association. Sovich is president of the APA, which represents 9,300 American Airline pilots.
The 18-member board is meeting in suburban Chicago and is expected to vote on American's contract proposal some time today, union officials said.
The road show will begin in Dallas, Texas and is expected to last nine days, Pitts told reporters here.
American Airlines is a subsidiary of AMR Corp.
